# The player's staff (generated by make_env.py): a dark haft with tan bands, three prongs round a glowing
# orb (unlit). Points down -Z (where the camera looks); origin at the grip, the orb 0.62 m ahead.
new
material new Haft --base-color 0.1490 0.1255 0.1137 --no-slot
material new Band --base-color 0.8784 0.6431 0.4314 --no-slot
material new Prong --base-color 0.3216 0.3255 0.2980 --no-slot
material new Orb --base-color 0.3412 0.6235 0.7059 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Haft --vertices 6 --radius 0.03 --depth 0.85 --location 0.000 0.100 0.000
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Haft
add mesh cylinder --name Band0 --vertices 6 --radius 0.04 --depth 0.05 --location 0.000 0.200 0.000
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Band
add mesh cylinder --name Band1 --vertices 6 --radius 0.04 --depth 0.05 --location 0.000 0.460 0.000
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Band
add mesh cube --name Prong0 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.600 0.055
scale 0.025 0.16 0.025
apply --scale
material assign Prong
add mesh cube --name Prong1 --size 1 --location -0.048 0.600 -0.028
scale 0.025 0.16 0.025
apply --scale
material assign Prong
add mesh cube --name Prong2 --size 1 --location 0.048 0.600 -0.028
scale 0.025 0.16 0.025
apply --scale
material assign Prong
add mesh ico-sphere --name Orb --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.06 --location 0.000 0.640 0.000
material assign Orb
select all
shade flat
export staff.glb
